article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Intensified vaccination efforts amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Indonesia is facing a significant measles outbreak with 8,372 confirmed cases, ranking second globally. Central Sulawesi is notably impacted, reporting 895 suspected cases, including 542 in Palu City. South Sumatra has recorded 1,587 cases, with Palembang contributing 808. Despite a decline in cases from 2,220 in week 1 to 195 in week 13, health authorities are ramping up vaccination efforts. The Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) strategy aims for 95% immunization coverage among children aged 9-59 months in affected areas. In Lebak Regency, 322 suspected cases have led to a targeted vaccination campaign for 10,401 children, with only 22% vaccinated thus far. The government stresses the urgency of vaccinations to prevent severe complications and control the outbreak, which has seen approximately 45 outbreaks across 29 districts in 11 provinces. In Jakarta, while there is a downward trend in cases, the highly contagious nature of measles necessitates strict protocols for schools to manage suspected cases and prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻疹：進行中の流行の中での予防接種努力の強化
triage.triage_reason: 確認感染者数8,372名、29地区11州に約45の流行が発生しており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」が明確に該当。複数州での同時流行と予防接種キャンペーン進行中であり、シグナルとして識別すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア全国での麻疹流行を明確に記述しており、中スラウェシ州（パル市）、南スマトラ州（パレンバン）、ジャカルタなど複数地域での同時流行を報告。2026年4月時点で確認感染者8,372名で世界第2位の規模。予防接種キャンペーン（ORI戦略）が進行中で政府関心も高い。麻疹は高い感染性を持つため、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクと流行拡大の可能性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination efforts ramp up amid severe outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Brazil is experiencing a significant influenza outbreak, with over 1,600 deaths reported nationwide. Influenza A accounts for 27.4% of positive respiratory cases and 36.9% of fatalities linked to respiratory viruses. Health alerts have been issued in fourteen capitals, including Rio de Janeiro and Salvador, due to an early and intense flu season compared to 2025. Belo Horizonte has declared a public health emergency, reporting a near doubling of respiratory-care visits in March, totaling 49,574, alongside 21 deaths and 381 hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) in Contagem. The National Vaccination Campaign, running from March 28 to May 30, aims to immunize 90% of priority groups, including the elderly, young children, and pregnant women. Authorities emphasize the importance of vaccination and mask use to mitigate transmission, as influenza cases have reached 3,584 in the first eleven weeks of 2026, marking a 95% increase from the previous year. Contagem has also declared a health emergency due to a spike in respiratory diseases, with a new H3N2 strain noted for its higher contagion.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザ：深刻な流行の中でワクチン接種推進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、死亡者1,600人超、複数都市での公衆衛生非常事態宣言、H3N2の新株による高い感染力など重症度・異常性が明確。
triage.notes: 2026年4月時点でブラジル全国でインフルエンザAの深刻な流行。1,600人超の死亡、複数都市（ベロオリゾンテ、コンタジェン）での公衆衛生非常事態宣言、H3N2新株による高い感染力、前年比95%の症例増加。国家予防接種キャンペーン実施中だが、管理医療能力への懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Government allocates funds for outbreak response
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Brazil is experiencing a chikungunya epidemic, particularly concentrated in Mato Grosso do Sul, which has reported 4,281 probable cases and 10 confirmed deaths. Dourados is the epicenter, with 1,572 confirmed cases, all fatalities occurring among Indigenous individuals, underscoring their vulnerability. Nationwide, Brazil has documented 24,378 probable cases and 15 deaths. In response, the Ministry of Health has allocated over R$3.1 million for healthcare and vector control, while local authorities have implemented extensive property inspections and mosquito control measures. The Indigenous SAMU has responded to over 10,730 calls, focusing on severe cases. Emergency measures include social support initiatives, with 6,000 food baskets planned for distribution. Dourados has announced a R$27.5 million funding package to enhance public health, including new ICU beds and expanded urgent care services. The region's positivity rate stands at 72.07%, indicating ongoing transmission and necessitating urgent health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニア：政府がアウトブレイク対応のための資金を配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。死亡事例、高い陽性率（72.07%）、先住民への脆弱性が確認され、フルRRA進行の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため、検証済み地域として列挙。マットグロッソドスル州での集中的な流行、先住民への不均衡な影響（全死亡例が先住民）、政府および地域当局の迅速な対応が特徴。高い陽性率と継続的な伝播の兆候から、監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Healthcare challenges amid significant case reductions
article.articleSummary: As of early 2026, Brazil has seen an 81% decrease in probable dengue cases in Acre, indicating a notable decline in disease activity. However, the healthcare system is under severe strain, with overcrowded hospitals and critical shortages of medical staff and equipment. In Paraná, Ibiporã has reported no new confirmed dengue cases since March 31, totaling 9 cases since January. In Minas Gerais, Montes Claros has 218 confirmed cases without fatalities, while Capitão Enéas has over 1,000 cases, prompting aggressive vector-control measures. Piauí has classified 28 municipalities as high-risk, reporting 4,202 probable cases and one death in 2026, leading to the activation of the Emergency Operations Center for enhanced monitoring. Additionally, Mato Grosso do Sul shows elevated arboviral risk, with several municipalities on alert for Aedes aegypti infestation. Authorities emphasize immediate actions to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, focusing on community engagement and vector control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：有意な患者数減少の中での医療課題
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱患者数は大幅に減少しているが、医療システムへの深刻な負荷、複数州での継続的な感染報告、および1死亡事例が報告されている。情報が不足しているため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおいてデング熱の患者数は81%減少と報告されているが、医療体制の逼迫、複数州での継続的な感染報告、ピアウイ州での死亡事例、および緊急対策センターの活性化が報告されている。デング熱は周期的に流行する風土病であり、患者数の減少は肯定的であるが、医療システムへの負荷と複数地域での継続的な感染は継続監視が必要。IHR基準はいずれも該当しないため、PICKUPには該当しないがWPRO基準の2項目該当およびより詳細な情報待機のためWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Intensified health measures amid rising pediatric cases
article.articleSummary: In early 2026, Vietnam's Khánh Hòa Province reported 1,388 cases of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) linked to Enterovirus 71 (EV71), with 9 severe cases but no fatalities. Ho Chi Minh City has recorded over 10,000 cases year-to-date, with 56% attributed to EV71. In week 14 alone, the city saw 1,347 new cases, marking a 64% increase from the previous four-week average. Two critically ill children were treated for stage-4 disease at Children's Hospital No. 2, requiring intensive medical support due to severe neurological symptoms and respiratory failure. Hotspots include Con Dao Special Zone and Long Dien, where incidence rates exceed 100,000 per 100,000 population. The rapid progression of cases without typical symptoms complicates timely diagnosis. Health authorities are enhancing surveillance and public health messaging, emphasizing hygiene in childcare settings to mitigate the outbreak. Warning signs include persistent high fever, altered consciousness, or seizures, necessitating urgent care even in the absence of rash.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのエンテロウイルス71：小児症例の増加に伴う保健対策の強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で4つ該当（異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）。小児における重症化例と高い感染率が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムにおけるエンテロウイルス71の大規模発生。ホーチミン市での年初累計10,000例以上（EV71が56%を占める）、第14週で前4週平均比64%増と急速な拡大を示唆。重症化例（神経症状・呼吸不全）が報告され、小児が主な影響を受けている。特にCon Dao特別区とLong Dienでの罹患率が100,000人あたり100,000を超える高リスク地域の存在が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Paratyphoid in Vietnam: Food safety measures implemented to combat contamination
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City is addressing a suspected Salmonella outbreak linked to food contamination, affecting 148 students from Bình Quới Tây Elementary School. Among these, 102 students are receiving outpatient care while 46 are hospitalized, all in stable condition. Initial tests confirmed Salmonella in 7 out of 10 fecal samples, with further strain identification ongoing. Symptoms reported include abdominal pain and vomiting, with 116 students showing signs of illness by April 8. In a related incident in Dak Lak Province, 86 individuals were hospitalized after consuming contaminated bread from Quốc Hùng bakery, which faced a fine of 80 million VND. Health authorities are emphasizing the importance of food safety measures to prevent further outbreaks, as investigations continue into the sources of contamination. Additionally, in Quang Ngai, there are reports of suspected bread poisoning with 11 suspected cases and 17 hospitalizations, prompting urgent directives and ongoing investigations.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのパラチフス：汚染対策のための食品安全対策が実施される

triage.notes: 複数の地域（ホーチミン市、ダクラク省、クアンガイ省）で関連する食品媒介性疾患の発生が報告されており、パターン化した集団発生の可能性がある。147名以上が罹患し、複数の検査で病原体が確認されたため、フルのRapid Risk Assessment（RRA）進行を推奨。

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数地域での食中毒アウトブレイク、多数の患者（234名超の患者数）、および継続的な感染曝露リスクがありフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 複数地域での同時アウトブレイク（ホーチミン市とダクラク省）、学校集団発症と食品汚染による発症の両様式を確認。患者数234名超、入院46名（学校）＋86名（ダクラク省）。サルモネラの確認試験済み。食品衛生改善の必要性を保健当局が認識している点から管理可能性評価も肯定的。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A in Brazil: Vaccination efforts intensify amid alarming case numbers
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, Brazil is facing a significant outbreak of Influenza A, with over 1,600 deaths reported this year. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin indicates that 27.4% of recent positive cases are due to Influenza A, which is responsible for 36.9% of deaths among respiratory viruses. The country has documented nearly 32,000 cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG), with influenza-related SRAG cases rising to 3,584, a notable increase from 1,838 during the same period in 2025. The emergence of Flu K, a mutation of Influenza A (H3N2), has worsened the outbreak, particularly in Santa Catarina, where cases have more than doubled compared to last year. In response, the Health Ministry launched a National Vaccination Campaign on March 28, aiming to vaccinate 90% of priority groups, including the elderly and young children, by May 30. In Teresina, A(H3N2) is the dominant strain, with flu-like syndrome cases increasing by 50.1% from the previous year, highlighting the urgent need for vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザA：懸念される症例数の増加の中でワクチン接種努力が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。重症度の高さ（1,600人以上の死亡、重症SRAG症例3,584件）と新変異株（Flu K）の出現により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 新規変異株（Flu K：H3N2亜型）の出現と前年比での大幅な増加傾向（SRAG症例が前年の1,838件から3,584件へ）が懸念要因。政府による全国予防接種キャンペーン（3月28日開始、目標は優先グループの90%）が進行中。国際的な監視と情報共有の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in China: Containment measures and economic impacts escalate
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) outbreaks caused by the South Africa Type I virus have been confirmed in at least 12 provinces across China, including Xinjiang and Gansu. Local authorities have implemented strict lockdown measures, closing cattle markets and restricting livestock movements to control the spread. In Xinjiang's Hami, public outrage erupted after officials forcibly removed sheep from homes. The disease primarily affects cattle and sheep, with mortality rates in calves reaching up to 90%. Emergency approvals for two new vaccines targeting the SAT1 strain were granted in early April, as existing vaccines do not protect against this variant. The outbreak is expected to lead to significant herd culling and increased beef prices, while the hog farming sector remains largely unaffected. The affected provinces account for about 16% of China's total cattle population, which is approximately 100 million. The virus's spread from western Siberia poses a further threat to livestock production in the region.

triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫が中国12省以上で確認され、異なるウイルス株（South Africa Type I）による多地域の異常な流行である。家畜への重大な影響（子牛の死亡率90%、大規模な群れの淘汰予測）があり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性が高く、国際的な家畜疾病管理への関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載された複数の中国の省（新疆、甘粛、黒龍江、河北、貴州、山東、山西、安徽、遼寧、吉林、内モンゴル自治区）はすべてChina内の地域であるため、verified_locationsにはChinaのみを記載した。South Africa Type I株による流行はWPRO地域にとって異常であり、既存ワクチン無効、新ワクチン緊急承認、西シベリアからの拡大リスクなど、複数の懸念要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Community efforts focus on prevention and control measures
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever continues to pose a significant health threat in Indonesia, with recent reports indicating 109 cases in Buleleng Regency, Bali, as of early April 2026, including a tragic death of a 4-year-old girl due to complications. In Mimika Regency, cases fluctuated from approximately 250 in 2024 to just 6 from January to March 2026, highlighting the effectiveness of local health initiatives. In Mataram City, 93 cases were reported from January to early April 2026, with authorities emphasizing the importance of early prevention strategies. The combination of dry-season heat and intermittent rains creates ideal conditions for mosquito breeding, particularly in densely populated areas. Local health officials are implementing community initiatives like Pembasmian Sarang Nyamuk (PSN) and the 3M Plus strategy to mitigate risks. They are also urging residents to maintain cleanliness and remove potential breeding sites. Continuous monitoring and an early warning system are in place to respond swiftly to any rising trends in dengue cases.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：地域社会による予防・管理対策が重点
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア複数地域でデング熱症例が報告されており、異常性と地域的影響が認められるが、死亡者1名（小児）に限定され、国際的拡大リスクが明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察段階が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで風土病的に存在する疾患であり、複数地域（バリ州ブレレン県、ミマイカ県、マタラム市）での症例報告は異常性が低い。ただし、乾期と散発的な降雨により蚊の繁殖条件が整っており、長期曝露と流行性の可能性がある。現地当局が積極的な予防対策（PSN、3M Plus戦略）を実施していることから管理可能性は中程度と評価される。IHR基準では死傷者報告により深刻性は認められるが、国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ明確でない。スクリーニング基準では重症度・長期曝露・流行易性で3項目該当。社会的・政治的関心は地域内で認められるが、国際支援必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Illness in India
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, India is facing notable disease activity primarily due to food poisoning and diarrhoea outbreaks. In Gujarat, a food poisoning incident linked to contaminated sev-khamani has affected 96 people, with 38 currently hospitalized. triage.headline_ja: インドで正体不明の疾患が発生
triage.triage_reason: 複数州で食中毒・下痢の集団発生が報告され、死亡例を含む。公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性（水系感染）があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで該当。
triage.notes: 複数州（オディシャ州、グジャラート州、ケーラ州）で同時多発的な集団感染が発生。オディシャ州ではジャジプル地区で水系感染が疑われる下痢アウトブレーク（死亡1、患者10）、グジャラート州ではアメダバードで食中毒事件（96人、入院38人）、ケーラ州では寺院祭典食に関連した大規模集団感染（150人以上、死亡1）。疾患名が「Unknown Illness」となっているが、記事本文では食中毒・下痢が明記されている。原因調査中であり、追加の確認情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Urgent vaccination campaigns to prevent further fatalities
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Vietnam's Tay Ninh Province has reported seven suspected rabies-related deaths this year, with the latest victim, a 66-year-old man, succumbing to the disease on April 7 after being bitten by an unvaccinated dog nearly a year prior. His symptoms included fatigue, hydrophobia, and seizures, highlighting the critical need for timely medical intervention. Another fatality occurred on April 3 under similar circumstances. In Dak Lak Province, a rabid dog bit five individuals on April 2, with one victim refusing vaccination despite showing symptoms of exposure. Local health authorities are intensifying public awareness campaigns and vaccination efforts, as current coverage remains low, with 85% of dogs and cats unvaccinated. The situation underscores the urgent need for enhanced veterinary surveillance and vaccination initiatives to prevent further rabies cases and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでの狂犬病：さらなる死亡を防ぐための緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の狂犬病死亡例（7件）が報告され、公衆衛生への重大な影響が確認される。ヒト-動物感染の連鎖が継続中であり、低いワクチン接種カバー率（動物側85%が未接種）により流行拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は発症後の致死率がほぼ100%と高く、複数死亡例および継続的な動物咬傷曝露がWPRO基準4項目に該当。当該地域での医療対応能力および予防ワクチン接種体制の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Vietnam: Enhanced surveillance following recent suspected cases
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Ca Mau Province in Vietnam has reported three suspected cases of meningococcal meningitis, including one confirmed death. The first patient, admitted on April 7, exhibited symptoms of fever, drowsiness, and neck stiffness, leading to a diagnosis of meningitis and septic shock. The second case, admitted on April 8, succumbed shortly after arrival. The third patient, admitted on April 9, presented with prolonged fever and was diagnosed with sepsis and pneumonia. All three cases had contact with a previously fatal case from mid-March. Local health authorities have initiated enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and sanitation measures in response to the situation. Laboratory tests confirmed two cases of Neisseria meningitidis, while the third tested negative due to prior antibiotic treatment. Although no large outbreak has been declared, health officials emphasize the importance of vaccination, which is not included in the national immunization program, urging individuals to seek private vaccination options and maintain hygiene practices.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：最近の疑い例に続く監視体制の強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。複数死亡例を含む確認症例、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、予防接種体制の課題があり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Ca Mau Province（Ca Mau州）での発生が主題。3例中2例が確定（Neisseria meningitidis検査陽性）、1例は死亡。中規模の連鎖感染の可能性あり。ベトナムの予防接種プログラムに髄膜炎菌ワクチンが未含有という制度的課題も重要。監視体制強化中の報告であり、推移の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in Brazil: Vaccination efforts ramp up amid respiratory illness crisis
article.articleSummary: Brazil is currently grappling with a significant public health crisis as respiratory illnesses, including severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS), have nearly doubled, with cases rising from 1,838 to 3,584 between January and mid-March 2026. Over 800 deaths have been linked to these respiratory viruses, contributing to a total of approximately 14,000 SARS cases nationwide. In response, the government has intensified vaccination campaigns, aiming for 90% coverage among priority groups such as children, the elderly, and health workers, with around 6 million doses administered by mid-March. Despite some regions showing a decline in respiratory virus activity, Acre remains on high alert due to persistent high incidence rates. The situation is further complicated by the circulation of Influenza A, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), and COVID-19, which has altered the seasonality of respiratory viruses, raising concerns about potential hospital overwhelm. Belo Horizonte has declared a health emergency, with respiratory-care visits nearly doubling in March, prompting urgent measures to expand healthcare capacity.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのCOVID-19：呼吸器疾患危機の中でワクチン接種の取り組みが加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な症例急増、国際的拡大リスク）。ブラジル全域での呼吸器ウイルスの大規模流行、800人超の死亡、医療逼迫の懸念があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事ではCOVID-19と並行してインフルエンザA、RSV、SARSなど複数の呼吸器ウイルスの同時流行を報告。季節性の変化、地域的医療逼迫（ベロオリゾンテが健康非常事態宣言）、ワクチン接種キャンペーン展開中。対象国はBrazilのみに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Urgent call for enhanced food safety protocols
article.articleSummary: Recent Listeria monocytogenes cases in China have led to severe health consequences, including the death of a 35-year-old pregnant woman and her unborn child after consuming contaminated refrigerated leftovers. This incident highlights the pathogen's ability to thrive in cold environments, earning it the nickname 'fridge killer.' Symptoms of Listeria infection, such as severe headaches, fever, and altered consciousness, require immediate medical attention. Health experts emphasize the critical need for improved food safety practices, especially for vulnerable groups like pregnant women, who are at a significantly higher risk. Preventive measures include proper food handling, thorough reheating of leftovers to at least 70°C, and avoiding high-risk foods such as ready-to-eat salads and unpasteurized dairy. The urgency for public awareness and stricter food safety protocols has been underscored to prevent further infections and protect at-risk populations.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のリステリア：食の安全プロトコルの強化への緊急呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。妊産婦と胎児の死亡例を含む重症例、食品由来感染の社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Listeria monocytogenes による食品由来感染で妊産婦死亡例が確認。「冷蔵庫の殺し屋」と呼ばれる病原体の冷温環境での増殖能力、易感染性集団への高リスク、国際的な食品安全問題としての波及リスクが高い。中国国内の食品安全管理強化と国際的な注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Clinical trials and outbreak risks during hot season
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Vietnam has reported 31,927 dengue cases, marking a 2.2-fold increase compared to the same period last year, indicating a significant escalation in transmission. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) has noted that dengue transmission levels are considerably above normal. In response, Hyundai BioScience has initiated a global clinical trial for a new dengue treatment, with the first patient dosed at Tien Giang Hospital on April 9, 2026. This trial aims to evaluate a universal antiviral therapy platform, potentially expediting regulatory review based on efficacy data. Additionally, the first quarter of 2026 has seen a rise in complex pediatric infectious diseases, including dengue, which poses increased risks to children. The hot season has heightened the risk of infectious disease outbreaks, with dengue, hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD), and Japanese encephalitis being particularly concerning. The extreme heat and humidity create ideal conditions for mosquito breeding, exacerbating transmission in urban areas.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：臨床試験と熱季中の流行リスク
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱の新規症例が昨年同期比2.2倍に増加し、ECDC が感染レベルが通常を大きく上回ることを確認。国際的臨床試験も進行中で、IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、社会的・医学的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナムのデング熱流行を主題とし、昨年同期比2.2倍の症例増加、ECDC による確認、国際的臨床試験の進行などが記載されている。熱季中の蚊媒介感染症リスク増加も指摘されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。国際的な臨床試験が進行中という点も社会的・政治的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Brazil: Vaccination efforts aim to reduce disease impact
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, Brazil is facing a critical situation regarding meningococcal meningitis, particularly in Paraná and Maceió. In Paraná, five deaths have been reported in early 2026, a decrease from nine in the previous year, with total cases dropping from 233 to 175 during the first ten weeks of the year. Health officials attribute this decline to successful vaccination campaigns, with meningococcal C vaccine coverage reaching 97.9%. In Maceió, a confirmed case at the Federal University of Alagoas prompted the suspension of in-person classes, highlighting the ongoing threat. A tragic incident involved the death of a 1-year-old from meningococcal type B. Authorities are urging the public to keep vaccination records updated and to seek immediate medical attention for symptoms such as high fever and neck stiffness. Prophylactic treatments are being administered to close contacts of affected individuals, emphasizing the importance of vaccination in preventing severe outcomes.

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in Vietnam: Urgent health measures needed to protect children
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Vietnam has reported over 25,000 cases of hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) in the first quarter, with a significant increase in Ho Chi Minh City. The hot and humid climate is facilitating the spread of HFMD, particularly cases caused by Enterovirus 71 (EV71), which has severe neurological implications. Recently, two critically ill children were treated in Ho Chi Minh City for EV71-related HFMD; one child, a 1-year-old, faced respiratory failure and required intensive care, while a 3-year-old exhibited severe neurological symptoms. Both cases underscore the urgent need for protective health measures, especially for vulnerable populations like children. In the past week alone, Ho Chi Minh City reported 1,347 new HFMD cases, bringing the year-to-date total to over 10,000. With EV71 accounting for approximately 56% of HFMD samples, health authorities are emphasizing the importance of recognizing warning signs such as persistent high fever and motor disorders to mitigate the impact of this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの手足口病：子どもを守るための緊急保健対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「重大な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」の2基準に該当し、かつWPRO基準で重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の3項目に該当する。EV71による神経症状を伴う重症例の発生と急速な患者増加が確認されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年4月現在、ベトナムで手足口病（HFMD）が流行中。第1四半期で25,000件以上の報告があり、ホーチミン市では過去1週間で1,347件の新規症例が報告されている。EV71が検出症例の56%を占め、神経合併症による重症例（呼吸不全、神経症状）が報告されている。対象国ベトナムでの実確認イベントのため、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in China: Vaccination and awareness vital during peak season
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis is currently at its peak season in China, particularly during the winter-spring months. The China CDC has issued warnings about the disease's high contagion and rapid progression, with symptoms including sudden high fever, severe headache, vomiting, and non-blanching skin purpura. The incubation period ranges from 1 to 7 days, and asymptomatic carriers can spread the infection. High-risk groups include students in crowded settings, infants under one year, adolescents, and travelers to endemic regions. Vaccination is essential for prevention, with options available through the National Immunization Program and voluntary vaccines. Personal preventive measures such as avoiding crowded spaces and practicing good hygiene are recommended. Close contacts of infected individuals may require chemoprophylaxis. Prompt medical attention is crucial for anyone experiencing severe or rapidly worsening symptoms, as the disease can lead to permanent complications or death within hours.

triage.headline_ja: 中国における髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：ピークシーズンにはワクチン接種と啓発が重要
triage.triage_reason: 中国でのピークシーズン警告と高い感染性が確認されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性）に複数該当するが、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、流行規模の情報が不足しているため、引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: China CDCがピークシーズンの警告を発行し、学生や乳幼児などの高リスク群が特定されている。ただし、現在の患者数、死亡者数、具体的な地域範囲が記事サマリーに記載されていないため、フルRRAには詳細情報の収集が必要。ワクチン戦略が既に展開されていることから、国内対応能力は一定程度あると思われるが、確実性を欠く。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Brazil: Efforts yield significant reductions in mortality rates
article.articleSummary: Brazil reported 1,128 malaria cases, with 98% being autochthonous, primarily in Bolívar, Apure, Amazonas, Barinas, and Trujillo. In response, health authorities are implementing interventions such as distributing insecticide-treated nets, promoting early diagnosis, enhancing community surveillance, and ensuring rapid outbreak responses. These efforts aim to control malaria transmission and reduce new infections. Notably, malaria deaths in the Yanomami Indigenous Territory decreased by 80% in 2025 compared to 2023, alongside a 53.2% decline in malnutrition-related deaths. The proportion of children under five with adequate weight increased from 45.4% to 53.8%. The improvements are attributed to expanded health access following a public health emergency, with health personnel increasing from 690 to 2,130 and over 1,400 water filters installed for safe drinking water. The newly opened Surucucu Indigenous Health Reference Center has conducted 4,374 visits, serving 48 Yanomami communities, contributing to a 76% reduction in acute respiratory infection lethality and a 16.7% drop in respiratory disease deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのマラリア：死亡率の大幅な削減に向けた取り組みが成果を上げている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでマラリア症例が報告されているが、記事の主題は死亡率の削減と公衆衛生対応の成功事例であり、新規の公衆衛生上の危機ではない。国際的な拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の対象地域はブラジル（Roraima、Amazonas州など）だが、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない。また、記事内容は死亡率低下と対応策の成功を報告する内容であり、シグナルとしての危機性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Vietnam: Food safety violations and virus spread raise alarms
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, a preschool in Thái Nguyên Province was fined 22.5 million dong for serving pork contaminated with African swine fever (ASF) to children, highlighting significant food safety violations. This incident, which occurred on March 25, led to an investigation after parents expressed concerns about the meat served during lunch. Testing confirmed ASF in the pork, prompting local health authorities to take immediate action, including suspending the principal for 15 days. Despite the serious nature of the violation, no human cases of ASF have been reported, underscoring the need for stringent food safety measures in public meal programs. Concurrently, the rapid spread of recombinant ASF virus genotypes I and II has been observed across northern and central Vietnam from January 2023 to August 2024. Testing of 182 clinical samples from 26 provinces confirmed the presence of ASFV DNA, with genotype II detected nationwide. The emergence of these recombinant strains raises concerns about increased risks in high-density pig production systems.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのアフリカンスワインフィーバー：食品安全違反とウイルス拡散が懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: アフリカンスワインフィーバーは動物疾患であり、ベトナムでの急速な拡大が報告されているものの、ヒト感染例がなく、現在の情報では国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確でないため。動物疾患監視の観点から経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: アフリカンスワインフィーバーは動物疾患（豚に対する病原体）であり、ヒト感染の報告はない。ただしベトナムでの2023年1月から2024年8月にかけての急速な拡大、複数州における組み換え株の検出、食品安全違反が報告されているため、動物衛生・食品セキュリティの観点から注視が必要。対象国（WPRO地域）での継続的な監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Brazil: Public health challenges amid multiple respiratory viruses
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) accounts for 17.7% of positive respiratory virus cases, as reported by the Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin. Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) activity remains high, particularly in the North, Central-West, Northeast, and Southeast regions. Influenza A is the most prevalent respiratory virus, representing 27.4% of positive cases and contributing to 36.9% of respiratory virus-related deaths. Fourteen capitals, including Belo Horizonte, Rio de Janeiro, and Salvador, are under alert for SRAG. Acre continues to show elevated SRAG incidence, prompting ongoing monitoring despite a national downturn in some respiratory viruses. Public health measures emphasize a National Vaccination Campaign against Influenza, highlighting the importance of masking, hand hygiene, and isolation for symptomatic individuals. In Sergipe, Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases remain elevated for the sixth consecutive week, with 13 states still at alert level. Vaccination is urged for high-risk groups, including children and the elderly, while pregnant women are advised to receive the RSV vaccine to protect newborns.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの呼吸器合胞体ウイルス（RSV）感染：複数の呼吸器ウイルス流行下での公衆衛生上の課題
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるRSVの流行は重要な公衆衛生課題であり、複数の呼吸器ウイルス(インフルエンザAも含む)の同時流行が報告されている。しかし、IHR基準の国際的な感染拡大やWHO通知レベルの深刻性まで至る明確なエビデンスが記事サマリーから判断しにくく、情報の詳細さが不十分であるため、継続的な経過観察が必要な段階と判定。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の複数州（北部、中西部、北東部、南東部地域など11州以上）に渡るRSV流行およびインフルエンザA流行が同時進行している。SRAG（重症急性呼吸器疾患）患者数が複数週間にわたり高い状態が続いており、13州がアラート状態。ただし記事はインフルエンザAに重点を置いているため、RSVの具体的な重症度や死亡数に関する情報が限定的。Fiocruzの定期監視レポートに基づいていることから信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Urgent vaccination efforts amid rising case counts
article.articleSummary: Indonesia is experiencing a significant measles outbreak, with the WHO projecting the country to rank second globally for cases by 2025, estimating a total of 17,204 confirmed instances. As of week 8 in 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 8,372 confirmed cases and 10,453 suspected cases. The highly contagious virus can infect up to 18 individuals from a single case and remains viable in the air for up to two hours, increasing transmission risks in crowded areas. Complications from measles, including pneumonia and encephalitis, pose severe health threats, even to adults. In Sidoarjo Regency, East Java, 74 suspected cases are under monitoring, with laboratory results pending due to reagent shortages. While no severe symptoms have been reported, routine vaccination efforts continue, and health officials are advocating for enhanced maternal and neonatal care. The situation underscores the urgent need for vaccination and public health interventions to mitigate the outbreak's impact.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻疹：症例数増加の中での緊急ワクチン接種努力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国レベルの大規模麻疹流行を示唆している。WHO予測で2025年に世界第2位の症例数、2026年第8週時点で8,372確定例と10,453疑い例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い伝播性（1症例から最大18人に感染）と深刻な合併症（肺炎、脳炎）を特徴とする。WHO予測で2025年に世界第2位の症例国となる見通し。試薬不足により診断確認が遅延している懸念あり。東ジャワ州スドアルジョで74疑い例が監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Vietnam: Investigation launched after fatalities and suspected cases
article.articleSummary: In Ca Mau Province, Vietnam, three individuals are suspected of having meningococcal meningitis, with one confirmed death reported. The local CDC initiated an epidemiological investigation on April 10, following the first patient's admission on April 7, who exhibited severe symptoms including altered consciousness and a purpuric rash. The second patient, admitted on April 8, rapidly deteriorated and died on April 9 due to septic shock, with underlying health issues noted. The third patient, admitted on April 9, presented with fever and respiratory symptoms and is currently under observation. All three patients had contact with a deceased individual who exhibited symptoms in mid-March. Health authorities are monitoring close contacts for 10 days to prevent further spread. As of now, no new suspected cases have been reported, and health officials remain vigilant in their response to the situation.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：死亡例と疑い事例の後、調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのカマウ省で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の疑い事例3件（死亡1件）が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、既に当局が調査を実施している。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は国際保健規則(IHR 2005)で特に注視すべき疾患。死亡例の存在、複数患者の短期間での発症、敗血症による急速な悪化パターン、接触者の監視体制確立など、既存の対応が進行中であることが確認される。ウイルス型の確定と接触追跡の成功度が今後の判定に重要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination efforts focus on vulnerable groups
article.articleSummary: In Ceará, Brazil, there have been 977 reported cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) related to influenza in the last four weeks, with 865 confirmed cases as of epidemiological week 13. The outbreak predominantly affects children aged 1–4 years, who represent 25.5% of cases, and individuals aged 70 and older at 21.4%. In response, Ceará has launched a vaccination campaign, receiving 760,000 doses from the Ministry of Health, targeting vulnerable populations such as children under 6, pregnant women, seniors, the homeless, and healthcare workers. Meanwhile, in Pernambuco, two influenza-associated SRAG cases are reported daily, with 1,371 total cases and 29 deaths as of April 10. Vaccination efforts have reached 322,045 individuals, with 238,756 from priority groups, aiming for a 90% coverage rate. Hospital capacity is under strain, with high occupancy rates in neonatal and pediatric ICUs. Additionally, RSV vaccinations for pregnant women are being implemented, with 38,541 doses administered.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザ：脆弱集団を対象とした予防接種の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ関連SARIの集中的な発生が報告されており、小児と高齢者が主に影響を受けている。ただし、既に予防接種キャンペーンが展開中であり、国内対応が進行中のため、現段階ではIHR基準の国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限のリスクは明確でなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（セアラ州およびペルナンブーコ州）でのインフルエンザ関連SARI事例の集中的な発生を報告している。小児（1-4歳が25.5%）および高齢者（70歳以上が21.4%）が主に影響を受けている。セアラ州で977例、ペルナンブーコ州で1,371例（29死亡）が報告されており、小児およびNICU/小児ICUの病床逼迫が認識されている。ただし、既に大規模な予防接種キャンペーン（セアラ州で760,000回分）が進行中であり、国内対応能力は存在するものと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Brazil: Public health efforts intensify amid increasing case counts
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports over 85,000 new tuberculosis (TB) cases annually, leading to approximately 6,000 deaths. In 2025, Acre recorded 502 cases, with a high incidence rate of 56.8 per 100,000, significantly above the national average of 39.5. The majority of cases in Acre were pulmonary TB (88.2%), which is highly transmissible. The gender distribution showed a predominance of males at 63.3%. HIV testing among TB patients was extensive, with 95.8% tested, and 5.4% of cases were coinfected with HIV. Cure rates for new TB cases were reported at 81.5%, with slightly higher rates for pulmonary TB. However, treatment abandonment was concerning, particularly among pulmonary cases, where it reached 10.3%. The Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS) provides free diagnosis and treatment, emphasizing the importance of early detection and adherence to therapy to combat TB transmission and prevent drug resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 結核について：症例数の増加に伴い公衆衛生対策が強化される（ブラジル）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける結核は依然として公衆衛生上の課題であり、高い発症率と治療中断率が報告されている。しかし、既知の地域的流行パターンであり、即座にフルRRA実施を要する新規シグナルとしては評価しがたい。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの結核報告データを示しており、年間85,000以上の新規症例と約6,000の死亡が報告されている。Acre州での高い発症率（人口10万当たり56.8）が強調されている。しかし、これは既知のブラジル国内の公衆衛生上の課題であり、異常な流行の急増や国際的な拡大のシグナルではない。治療中断率の上昇は懸念事項だが、SUSによる無料治療提供体制が存在する。スクリーニング基準は3つ該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみで、国際的拡大のリスクや予想外の異常性に欠ける。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in India: Monitoring new variants and enhancing public health strategies
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, COVID-19 remains a concern in India, with a new variant identified through INSACOG genomic surveillance showing signs of increased transmissibility, particularly in crowded settings. While nationwide case numbers are currently low, some cities are experiencing clusters, with daily cases rising from single digits to several hundred, although hospitalizations remain stable. The pandemic has highlighted critical lessons for future health threats, emphasizing the need for a comprehensive public health strategy that includes a One Health approach and community engagement. Vaccination efforts have been significant, with over 90% of adults receiving their first dose, but booster uptake is low, and current vaccines target older variants. Experts stress the importance of strengthening primary care, early detection, and robust health capacities to address ongoing challenges, including misinformation and the need for wastewater monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19 in India: Monitoring new variants and enhancing public health strategies（インドにおけるCOVID-19：新規変異株の監視と公衆衛生戦略の強化）
triage.triage_reason: 新規変異株の検出と感染性増加の兆候が報告されているが、現在の全国症例数は低く、ホスピタライゼーションは安定している。継続的な監視が必要だが、現時点ではIHR基準の閾値に達していない。
triage.notes: INSACOG（インド SARSCoV-2ゲノム監視コンソーシアム）により新規変異株が確認されており、伝播性増加の兆候が検出されている。しかし全国レベルでは症例数が少なく、入院は安定している。ワクチン接種率は高いが、ブースター接種率が低いという課題がある。国家的な公衆衛生戦略強化の必要性が強調されており、今後の変異株動向の注視が重要。国際的な拡大リスクについては情報不足のため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Norovirus in China: Spring season sees multiple viral threats
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, China is facing an active circulation of norovirus gastroenteritis alongside five other viruses, including human avian influenza and monkeypox. This seasonal wave is characterized by a resurgence of known pathogens rather than new strains. The China CDC and National Center for Disease Control have issued guidance highlighting five protective measures: proper mask usage, thorough handwashing, regular ventilation, minimizing gatherings, and specific precautions for each virus. For norovirus, food safety and surface disinfection are emphasized. High-risk populations, including the elderly and those with chronic illnesses, are urged to seek immediate medical attention if symptoms arise. Concurrently, an April virus outbreak has led to crowded emergency departments, with common symptoms such as fever, cough, vomiting, and diarrhea affecting the elderly, children, pregnant women, and the immunocompromised. Families are advised to adopt six essential practices to mitigate risks, including proper mask usage, hand hygiene, and food safety measures.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のノロウイルス：春季は複数のウイルス脅威に直面
triage.triage_reason: 中国でノロウイルスを含む複数ウイルスの同時流行が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）で複数該当するが、季節的既知病原体の再出現であり新規株ではないため、現時点で国際的拡大リスクが明確でない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中国国内の季節的なノロウイルスを含むウイルス同時流行を報告している。既知病原体の再出現であり、新規株や未知の脅威ではない点がIHR基準への該当を限定している。ただし、高リスク集団への影響、複数病原体の同時流行、医療現場の混雑は監視対象。追加情報があれば評価を更新する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Indonesia: Ongoing prevention efforts amid rising mosquito activity
article.articleSummary: Malaria continues to dominate as the primary infectious disease in the Timika health center service area of Mimika District, Central Papua, Indonesia, with stable case counts reported from January 2022 to April 2026. The local health authority, led by Dr. Mozes Untung, has implemented ongoing education and vector-control initiatives to mitigate malaria transmission. These efforts include monthly larval surveys to identify mosquito breeding sites, abatisation to eliminate larvae, and fogging operations at public venues upon request. However, extreme heat conditions have heightened mosquito aggressiveness, prompting the Timika Community Health Center to enhance surveillance and prevention strategies. In response to a recent spike in dengue cases among students, the health center plans mass malaria screenings and intensified fogging in schools. The community is urged to maintain hygiene and manage waste effectively to combat both malaria and dengue, as the dry-season heat and intermittent rains create favorable conditions for mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのマラリア：蚊の活動増加の中での予防対策の継続的努力
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でのマラリア継続報告であり、スクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な重症度情報や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の詳細が不足しており、追加情報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2022年1月から2026年4月までの安定したマラリア症例の継続報告。地方保健当局による継続的な予防対策が実施されており、政府の関心は確認できるが、症例数の増減、死亡数、入院数などの重症度指標が記載されていない。デング熱症例の増加との併行報告もあり、ベクター媒介感染症の増加傾向を示唆しているが、詳細が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in China: Emerging cases in northern provinces raise concerns
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and chikungunya are increasingly reported in northern China as warmer weather approaches, with local transmission now observed in provinces such as Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, Hebei, Beijing, and Tianjin. The Aedes albopictus mosquito is the primary vector, thriving in clean standing water near homes. Symptoms of dengue include high fever (39–40°C) lasting 2–7 days, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, rash, and potential vomiting. Chikungunya is marked by intense joint pain alongside fever and rash. As of April 10, 2026, China is experiencing active circulation of multiple viruses, including dengue, during this spring seasonal wave. Official health guidance emphasizes protective measures such as using mosquito repellents, wearing protective clothing, and seeking medical attention if symptomatic after travel. High-risk groups, including the elderly and chronically ill, are advised to seek prompt medical care for any symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のデング熱：北部地域の患者増加が懸念を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で5項目全て該当。北部地域での局所感染の拡大と季節的流行の発生は公衆衛生上の重大懸念である。
triage.notes: 山東省、河南省、陜西省、河北省、北京、天津の北部地域で局所感染が確認されており、従来のデング流行地域外での拡大が特に懸念される。Aedes albopictus（ヒトスジシマカ）による媒介とチクングニアの同時流行も報告されている。国際的な渡航者への健康リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in China: Northern provinces face increased mosquito-borne threats
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya and dengue fever cases are on the rise in northern China as warmer weather sets in. The Aedes albopictus mosquito, a key vector, is proliferating in urban areas with stagnant water. Historically confined to southern provinces like Guangdong and Yunnan, chikungunya is now being transmitted locally in regions such as Shandong, Henan, and Beijing. Symptoms include severe joint pain, fever, and rash, with joint pain potentially persisting for months. Health authorities are urging the public to adopt preventive measures, including the use of mosquito repellents and protective clothing, particularly for travelers returning from affected areas. As of April 10, 2026, six viruses, including chikungunya, are actively circulating in China, prompting health officials to recommend stringent protective measures such as mask-wearing, hand hygiene, and minimizing gatherings. High-risk individuals are advised to seek immediate medical attention if they exhibit symptoms after potential exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のチクングニア熱：北部地域の蚊媒介感染症の脅威増加
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の地理的拡大（南部から北部への拡散）、複数地域での局所伝播の確認、歴史的に異常な発生パターンが確認され、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性が複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱の中国北部地域への拡大を主題としており、歴史的に南部に限定されていた疾患が北京、山東、河南などの北部地域で局所伝播が確認されている点が特に注目される。ネッタイシマカの都市部での増殖と気候変動による媒介蚊の北上が背景にあるものと考えられる。公衆衛生当局による積極的な予防措置の呼びかけも記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A in China: Vaccination efforts target MSM amid ongoing transmission
article.articleSummary: In March, Hong Kong reported eight new Hepatitis A cases, all among men, linked to a cluster involving men who have sex with men (MSM). This cluster has expanded to 27 cases, with genomic analysis confirming that three of the new cases share identical virus sequences with earlier infections. The ages of the March cases ranged from 28 to 61 years. The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) is actively monitoring the situation and has initiated a free two-dose vaccination program for MSM, which has seen over 60 participants enroll within a month. Recent case counts show a decline, with 15 cases reported in January and 7 in February. The CHP emphasizes the importance of continued vigilance due to the long incubation period of Hepatitis A, which can sustain transmission for months to a year. The ongoing vaccination efforts aim to curb the spread among the MSM community.

triage.headline_ja: 中国におけるA型肝炎：MSM向けワクチン接種が継続的な感染の中で実施中
triage.triage_reason: 香港でのA型肝炎クラスター（27症例）は異常・予想外な事象であり、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たすが、死亡・重症化情報が明記されておらず、また現在ワクチン接種プログラムで管理下にあるため、フルRRA前に続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は香港（中国の特別行政区）でのA型肝炎クラスターを主題としており、MSM向けのターゲット化されたワクチン接種が実施されている。症例数は27に達しており、長い潜伏期間（数ヶ月～1年）により継続的な伝播リスクが存在する。ただし死亡率や入院率といった重症度情報が記事に明記されていないため、情報不足の観点から「WATCH」判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in Vietnam: Food safety measures intensified amid contamination concerns
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, a recent food poisoning outbreak in Dak Lak Province has led to 86 hospitalizations linked to contaminated bread from Quốc Hùng bakery. The outbreak, which began on March 27, was confirmed by health authorities, with patients discharged by early April. Laboratory tests identified Salmonella in several samples, alongside Escherichia coli in a vegetable sample. The bakery faced an administrative fine of approximately 80 million VND due to unsafe food handling practices. Concurrently, in Thai Nguyen Province, African swine fever was detected in pork served at Hoa Binh Preschool, prompting an investigation after parental concerns. Testing revealed microbial levels, including E. coli, within acceptable limits, but the meat supplier was fined 22.5 million VND for unsafe practices. The school has since switched suppliers and is under increased monitoring to ensure food safety. No illnesses among students have been reported, but authorities are enforcing stricter oversight to prevent future incidents.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおけるE. coli：食品汚染懸念の中で食品安全対策が強化される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の食中毒事件（Salmonella・E. coli検出）が報告され、86名の入院が発生。異常性と重症度の基準を満たすが、情報がやや古く（3月27日発症、4月初旬に患者退院済み）、現在進行中の流行かどうかが不明確なため。
triage.notes: 記事はDak Lak Province（ダクラク省）とThai Nguyen Province（タイグエン省）における食中毒事件を報告。Dak Lak省でのSalmonella・E. coli検出による86名の入院は重大だが、発症は3月27日で患者は4月初旬に退院済みのため既に事態は収束していると考えられる。現在進行中の流行リスク判定に情報不足がある。追加情報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Health measures intensified amid early case reports
article.articleSummary: As of early April 2026, India is witnessing early dengue cases, with Jharkhand reporting 14 confirmed cases, including four in Ranchi, the most affected district. Last year, Ranchi recorded 101 cases, prompting health authorities to enhance vigilance and increase testing kit supplies at Sadar Hospital for rapid diagnosis. Symptoms of dengue include high fever, severe body and joint pain, and potential internal bleeding, necessitating timely medical intervention. In Ludhiana, a health alert was issued following one dengue case and two malaria cases, with vector control measures intensified. The overlap in symptoms between dengue and malaria underscores the need for accurate blood tests to ensure proper treatment. The region's warm, humid conditions and urban waterlogging are contributing to increased mosquito breeding, raising concerns about potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: インドのデング熱：初期患者報告の中で保健措置が強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は季節性疾患で毎年発生が予想される疾患であり、現在の段階では「異常・予想外」とは言い難い。ただし複数州での早期発生報告と検査体制の強化が進行中であり、情報の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インドのジャルカンド州（Jharkhand）とルディアナ市（Ludhiana, Punjab州）での早期デング発生が報告されている。昨年ランチ地区で101例の記録があり、温暖湿潤な環境と都市の水たまりが蚊の繁殖を増加させている。季節性疾患であるため「異常」と判断しない一方、早期発生と複数地域での同時報告は経過観察の対象となる。死亡例や深刻な合併症の情報は記事に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in China: Vaccination and prevention strategies are critical
article.articleSummary: As of April 10, 2026, Nanchang City CDC reports a significant risk of measles transmission in China, attributed to a global resurgence of the virus. Measles, a highly contagious respiratory disease, is characterized by symptoms such as high fever (39–40°C), cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a distinctive rash that appears 3–4 days after initial symptoms. The current period is marked by high incidence, particularly during winter and spring, with substantial risks from imported infections. Vaccination remains the most effective preventive measure, with the first dose of the MMR vaccine recommended at 8 months and a second dose at 18 months. High-risk groups, including healthcare workers and travelers, are urged to ensure they are vaccinated. Daily preventive measures include wearing masks in crowded places, practicing hand hygiene, and ensuring good ventilation. Individuals suspected of having measles should isolate and seek medical attention, while schools are advised to exclude affected students for 5 days post-rash onset, extending to 10 days if complications occur.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の麻疹：ワクチン接種と予防戦略が重要
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は高い伝播性を持つ呼吸器疾患であり、冬春季の高い発生率と輸入感染のリスクが報告されているが、具体的な患者数、死亡者、国際拡大のリスク、医療システムへの負荷については記事に記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は南昌市CDC（疾病管理センター）による麻疹伝播のリスク報告を基盤としており、公衆衛生当局の関心が確認できる。しかし、具体的な患者数、確認患者、重症度、医療負荷に関する具体的なデータが欠落している。世界的な麻疹の再拡大という背景が提示されているが、中国における現在の流行規模の詳細は不明。続報で患者数や死亡者、医療システムへの影響が明らかになることで判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Oropouche in Brazil: Public health response to emerging viral threats
article.articleSummary: A public health alert has been issued in Brazil due to an infestation of Culicoides paraensis, the biting midge responsible for Oropouche fever, particularly in Ilhota, Santa Catarina. As temperatures rise to 30°C, residents are taking precautions against the disease, which presents symptoms similar to dengue, including fever and body aches. Current estimates suggest that Brazil could account for approximately 5.5 million Oropouche cases from 1960 to 2025, highlighting a significant underreporting of infections. Additionally, a recent outbreak in Ceará state has been linked to a new lineage of the Oropouche virus, with a confirmed case involving a 48-year-old woman who developed Guillain-Barré syndrome and visual impairment following infection. This case underscores the need for enhanced surveillance and public health measures to address the growing threat posed by environmental changes and emerging viral strains.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのオロポウシ熱：新興ウイルス脅威への公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際感染リスク）。ウイルスの新系統、ギランバレー症候群などの重症合併症、環境変化に伴う感染拡大が報告されており、シグナルとしてピックアップする。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準全5項目該当するため、国際的関心が高いシグナルとして判定。新系統ウイルスの出現、ギランバレー症候群などの神経合併症、推定550万件の過去感染例、気温上昇に伴うベクター増殖環境の形成が主な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Philippines: Preventive measures emphasized amid local transmission risks
article.articleSummary: As of April 11, 2026, the Philippines is experiencing a notable chikungunya outbreak, with cases increasing significantly in various regions. The latest reports indicate a surge in local transmission, particularly in areas with high mosquito populations. Health authorities are actively implementing control measures, including enhanced epidemiological surveillance and vector control strategies, to combat the spread of the disease. The primary vector, Aedes aegypti, thrives in the current rainy season, which contributes to the proliferation of mosquito breeding sites. Public health campaigns are focusing on educating communities about preventive actions, such as eliminating standing water, properly maintaining water storage containers, and ensuring that pools are adequately treated. With no vaccine or specific treatment available, these preventive measures are crucial in reducing transmission risks and protecting public health.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのチクングニア：地域的感染リスクの中で予防措置が強調される
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンにおけるチクングニアの顕著な流行報告。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な増加傾向、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当。シグナルとして識別し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、フィリピンで顕著なチクングニア流行が発生していることが明確。複数地域での地域感染、蚊媒介ベクター（ネッティーグブカ）の活動活発化、雨季による繁殖地の増加により流行しやすい状況。公衆衛生当局による積極的な対応がなされているが、ワクチンや特異的治療がない状況での予防策の強調。フィリピンはIHR通知対象候補国。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Recent fatalities highlight urgent public health concerns
article.articleSummary: In Tay Ninh province, Vietnam, seven individuals have succumbed to rabies following dog bites since early 2026. The latest victim, Phan Văn Đol, aged 66, died approximately one year post-exposure, exhibiting severe symptoms including hydrophobia and seizures. His case, along with six others, underscores the critical need for immediate medical attention after animal bites, as all victims were bitten by familiar household dogs. The incubation period for rabies in these cases varied from one month to a year. Local health authorities have issued warnings about the heightened risk of rabies transmission during the hot season, emphasizing the importance of vaccination and prompt treatment to prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの狂犬病：最近の死亡例は緊急の公衆衛生上の懸念を浮き彫りにしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）。ベトナムでの短期間での複数死亡例は公式通知基準を満たし、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムのタイニン省で2026年初頭以降7名の狂犬病死亡例が報告。最長1年の潜伏期間を示す例あり。地元保健当局が警告を発出し、ワクチン接種と迅速な治療の重要性を強調。複数州（タイニン、ロンアン、トラビン）にわたる地理的分布が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Health authorities implement measures to control outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, recent reports indicate a concerning situation regarding dengue fever, with health authorities actively monitoring and responding to cases. The Ca Mau CDC has initiated an epidemiological investigation following three suspected cases of meningococcal meningitis, one of which resulted in death. The first patient, admitted on April 7, exhibited severe symptoms including altered consciousness and purpuric rash, leading to a diagnosis of meningitis risk and septic shock. The second patient, who was admitted a day later, succumbed to high fever and confusion, progressing to coma before passing away. The third patient, admitted on April 9, presented with fever and respiratory symptoms, raising concerns of sepsis and dengue fever. All three individuals had contact with a deceased person in mid-March, prompting close monitoring of contacts for potential spread. Authorities are implementing containment measures to limit further transmission and are awaiting test results from the Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：保健当局が流行対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 複数の疑い患者（死亡者1名を含む）が報告され、異常な症状クラスター（メニンジェレス関連症状）を伴う重症度が高い。国内での積極的な疫学調査と接触者追跡が実施中であり、管理可能性に関する懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではデング熱の見出しながら、実際の記述はメニンジェレス髄膜炎および敗血症の疑い症例に関するもの。複数患者の死亡・重篤化、共通の接触歴（3月中旬の故人との接触）、および接触者追跡実施中であることから、クラスター調査が進行中と判断される。検査結果待機中（パスツール研究所）。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah in India: Recent outbreaks and health responses in the region
article.articleSummary: India has reported a resurgence of Nipah virus cases, with the latest outbreak linked to West Bengal. The state has seen a significant increase in cases, prompting health authorities to implement strict surveillance and containment measures. As of now, there have been multiple confirmed cases, with several fatalities reported. The government is actively monitoring the situation, conducting contact tracing, and raising public awareness about the virus's transmission. Health officials are also emphasizing the importance of preventive measures, especially in areas with a history of Nipah outbreaks. The situation remains critical as authorities work to control the spread and prevent further infections.

triage.headline_ja: インドのニパウイルス：地域における最近のアウトブレイクと保健対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。ニパウイルスは致死率が高く複数の死亡が報告されており、West Bengalでの再興的なアウトブレイクは異常。国際的な拡大リスクが高く、渡航制限の可能性も存在するため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: West Bengalでの再興的なニパウイルスアウトブレイクが確認されている。複数の確定例と複数の死亡が報告されており、政府による能動的な監視と接触者追跡が実施中。ニパウイルスはZoonotic pathogenであり、動物と人間双方に影響を及ぼしている。West Bengalはニパウイルス発症の歴史がある地域として特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Pregnant woman dies after consuming contaminated leftovers
article.articleSummary: In Zhengzhou, Henan, a 35-year-old pregnant woman died after contracting Listeria monocytogenes from refrigerator leftovers. This case underscores the heightened risk of listeriosis during pregnancy, which can lead to severe complications such as miscarriage and perinatal death. The woman experienced symptoms including fever and diarrhea three months after consumption. Listeria is known for its ability to survive in cold temperatures, making it a significant concern in food safety. Public health officials recommend thorough reheating of leftovers, avoiding prolonged cold storage, and maintaining strict hygiene in refrigerators to prevent contamination. Regular cleaning of fridge components is also advised to minimize risks associated with this pathogen.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でリステリア感染：汚染された残り物を摂取した妊婦が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 妊婦の死亡例を含む食品由来リステリア感染症の報告。重症度（死亡）と異常性が認められ、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻。
triage.notes: リステリア感染による妊婦死亡例は稀で、重大な公衆衛生イベント。記事では冷蔵庫の衛生管理や食品の安全な保管についての勧告が含まれており、当局の関与が示唆される。国内の食品安全管理に関する課題として認識されている可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Scrapie in Brazil: Concerns over export markets amid disease investigation
article.articleSummary: Argentina's Senasa is currently investigating a potential scrapie case in sheep from Santa Fe province, marking a significant concern as the country has been scrapie-free until now. The investigation follows the observation of symptoms in male Dorper pedigree sheep imported from Paraguay, leading to their sacrifice. Additionally, a ewe born to one of these imported animals later exhibited symptoms and has been sent for diagnostic testing. The situation has prompted the interdiction of the farm for 60 days, raising alarms about the potential suspension of export certificates for animal-origin products, pet foods, and dairy derivatives starting Friday. This could severely impact export markets, particularly for Algeria and China, which rely on these products. Brazil, while having atypical scrapie, may face complications as protocols for declaring 'scrapie-free' status will need to be renegotiated, further complicating trade relations in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Mpox in Brazil: Health authorities monitor suspected cases and response measures
article.articleSummary: A nursing technician in Itajaí, Santa Catarina, has been hospitalized with a suspected case of mpox, with a blood sample sent for analysis to a laboratory in Florianópolis. As of April 11, 2026, no confirmed cases of mpox have been reported in Itajaí. The Ministry of Health emphasizes the importance of immediate isolation for suspected or confirmed cases and advises against sharing personal items during the transmission period. Symptoms of mpox include skin eruptions with blisters or sores, fever, headaches, muscle pains, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes. The patient remains under observation at Hospital e Maternidade Marieta Konder Bornhausen, and health authorities are closely monitoring the situation.

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Disease in Brazil: Investigation follows child's death from meningitis
article.articleSummary: On April 8, 2026, an 8-year-old child died from suspected Meningococcal Disease at Hospital Geral de Areias in Recife, prompting an investigation by the Pernambuco State Health Secretariat (SES-PE). The health department has activated the Meningococcal Disease protocol, although no school closures are currently recommended. Selective chemoprophylaxis is being administered to close contacts of the child. Meningitis, characterized by inflammation of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord, can be caused by various pathogens, with bacterial and viral forms being of particular concern due to their potential severity. Bacterial meningitis often necessitates immediate hospitalization and antibiotic treatment, while viral meningitis may resolve with supportive care. Symptoms in children can include irritability and bulging fontanelle, making early recognition critical. The case remains under investigation as health officials monitor the situation closely.

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2 in Brazil: Health emergency declared amid rising respiratory illnesses
article.articleSummary: Contagem, Minas Gerais, has declared a health emergency due to a significant increase in respiratory diseases linked to a new strain of H3N2 influenza. As of April 7, 2026, the municipality reported 21 deaths and 381 confirmed cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). Mayor Ricardo Faria indicated that approximately 5,000 cases of respiratory syndromes have been reported, with children and the elderly being the most affected demographics. This surge has placed considerable pressure on local urgent care facilities. In response to the crisis, the city has opened 10 new pediatric ICU beds and hired additional pediatricians as of April 8. The local government is focusing on strengthening the health system, particularly for specialized consultations, while also addressing logistical challenges related to school kits and creche vacancies.

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Disease in Vietnam: Recent cases prompt health response and vaccination efforts
article.articleSummary: Cà Mau Province in Vietnam has reported three suspected cases of meningococcal disease, including one fatality. The first patient, a 37-year-old woman, was admitted on April 7 with fever of unknown origin, meningitis, and septic shock; her sample was sent for testing to the Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City. The second case involved a 66-year-old woman who was admitted on April 8 with symptoms of fever, confusion, and rapid breathing, diagnosed with meningitis and septic shock, and unfortunately died on April 9. Her death was attributed to septic shock from a gastrointestinal infection, complicated by multiple comorbidities. The third case is a 31-year-old woman admitted on April 9 with prolonged fever, suspected of having septicemia, dengue, and pneumonia; her samples are also under analysis. All three patients had contact with a previously reported fatal case from mid-March 2026. In response, health authorities have initiated investigations, contact tracing, and environmental disinfection, while the demand for meningococcal vaccination has increased.

article.articleHeadline: Lassa Fever in Ghana: Ongoing outbreak raises public health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of January 2026, Lassa fever continues to pose a significant threat in West Africa, with Nigeria reporting a death toll of 167 this year. Although confirmed cases have decreased from 51 to 26 in the latest update, fatalities are still increasing. The disease, which is transmitted through rodent droppings and can spread between humans, leads to severe hemorrhagic fever. The outbreak is particularly prevalent in rural areas, prompting public health officials to emphasize the importance of minimizing contact with rodents to prevent further transmission. Ghana, along with other neighboring countries, remains vigilant as Lassa fever cases are monitored, highlighting the need for continued public health interventions and awareness.

article.articleHeadline: HIV in Brazil: High TB-HIV co-infection rates reported
article.articleSummary: In 2025, Acre, Brazil, reported 502 tuberculosis (TB) cases, with an incidence rate of 56.8 per 100,000, significantly higher than the national average of 39.5. Among these cases, 443 (88.2%) were pulmonary TB, the most contagious form. The gender distribution showed a predominance of males at 63.3%. HIV testing among TB patients was notably high at 95.8%, with 27 individuals (5.4%) diagnosed with TB-HIV co-infection; 74.1% of these were receiving antiretroviral therapy. The post-mortem diagnosis rate was low, with only two cases (0.3%). Cure rates for new TB cases were promising at 81.5%, with slightly higher rates for pulmonary TB at 81.8% and laboratory-confirmed cases at 83.2%. Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) was implemented in 43.3% of cases, while treatment abandonment was recorded at 9.6%, increasing to 10.3% for pulmonary TB.

article.articleHeadline: Measles in India: Reinfection concerns amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: India is currently facing significant challenges with measles, as recent reports indicate a troubling trend of reinfections among children who had previously recovered. The latest data reveals a surge in suspected cases, with thousands reported across various regions. Hospitals are overwhelmed, with many children requiring intensive care due to complications arising from the disease. Health officials emphasize the importance of vaccination and monitoring for early signs of reinfection, as measles can severely compromise the immune system, leading to increased risks of pneumonia, diarrhea, and malnutrition. The situation is exacerbated by limited hospital resources, with many facilities operating at full capacity. Public health campaigns are being intensified to address the outbreak and educate communities on the importance of nutrition and preventive measures.

The situation underscores the importance of vaccination and public health measures to combat the spread of measles and other infectious diseases.

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Indonesia: Intensified efforts to control disease spread
article.articleSummary: In South Sumatra, Indonesia, tuberculosis (TB) continues to pose a significant public health challenge. As of March 2026, 3,148 TB cases have been detected, with a provisional treatment coverage of 9.68%. This follows a total of 24,748 cases identified and treated in 2025, representing a treatment coverage of 65.34% of the estimated incidence. The highest number of cases is reported in densely populated areas, particularly Palembang City, with additional clusters in Banyuasin, Ogan Komering Ilir, and Muara Enim. Contributing factors to the spread include poor housing conditions, close contact with infected individuals, diabetes, and socioeconomic challenges. In response, the South Sumatra Health Office is enhancing community-based Active Case Finding (ACF) initiatives, which include intensive contact investigations and collaboration across sectors, aiming to align with national TB elimination goals.

Ongoing investigations aim to determine the linkage of cases and assess the risk of the disease spreading to neighboring countries.

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in China: Urgent health measures recommended for families
article.articleSummary: In April 2026, China experienced a significant outbreak of Enterovirus 71, alongside other viral infections such as influenza and norovirus, leading to increased emergency department visits. The national disease-control centers and CCTV have issued urgent warnings highlighting the common symptoms, which include fever, cough, vomiting, and diarrhea. Vulnerable populations, particularly the elderly, children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals, are at heightened risk. To mitigate the spread, families are advised to adhere to six critical health practices: proper mask usage in crowded spaces, thorough handwashing, daily room ventilation, regular disinfection of high-touch surfaces, food safety measures, and maintaining distance from those who are ill. These guidelines aim to protect public health and reduce the impact of the ongoing viral activity.
